instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not give which slot is live after restore, PIN TTL rules, or cert handle vs label rules; solver must engage soft-token state and Java modules.

discovery_budget.discovery: After restore, duplicate key labels exist on archive and live slots; the provider currently binds the archive slot id while findscan still counts objects on both.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the archive-vs-live bind and that findscan is count-only collapses diagnose and discoverability.

discovery_budget.discovery: PIN-cached login state outlives the posted ttl_sec across simulated fork/reload unless op_b refreshes session lineage independently of object handles.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating flush-before-reuse order turns the task into a recipe checklist.

discovery_budget.discovery: Cert identity must re-anchor by label on the live slot after handle reclaim; stale handles remain findable via offline scan but must fail handle_valid authorization.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Telling solvers handle vs label split removes the coupling that makes partial fixes fail.
